title: Tracking the Stepwise Formation of the Dysprosium Cluster (Dy10) with Multiple Relaxation Behavior

material_class.structural_family: decanuclear Dy10 nanocluster of two triangular Dy3 units linked by four Dy3+ ions through μ5-NO3- bridges

synthesis.procedure: 0.25 mmol Dy(NO3)3·6H2O, 0.25 mmol Dy(OAc)3·6H2O, 0.5 mmol 3-ethoxy-2-hydroxybenzaldehyde (L2), 0.5 mmol 3-amino-1,2-propanediol (L3), and 0.4 mmol triethylamine were dissolved in 30 mL MeOH/CH3CN (1:1 v/v) and stirred at room temperature for 2 h. The mixture was transferred to a Pyrex tube, heated at 80 °C for 2 days, then cooled to room temperature to give yellow massive crystals. Ligand L1 forms in situ from L2 and L3.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal reaction in a Pyrex tube
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: after heating, the tube was removed from the oven to room temperature; yellow massive crystals formed directly

properties.summary: Dy10 is a homometallic Dy-exclusive cluster showing SMM-like multiple magnetic relaxation. DC susceptibility indicates weakly antiferromagnetic coupling and large magnetic anisotropy. AC data under 0 Oe DC field show two independent relaxation processes.
